title: Virgin
summary: VIR'GIN, noun nearly vur'gin. [Latin virgo.] 1. A woman who has had no carnal knowledge of man. 2. A woman not a mother. [Unusual.] 3. The sign Virgo. [See Virgo.] VIR'GIN, adjective 1. Pure; untouche

inlines.v: VIR'GIN, noun nearly vur'gin. [Latin virgo.] 1. A woman who has had no carnal knowledge of man. 2. A woman not a mother. [Unusual.] 3. The sign Virgo. [See Virgo.] VIR'GIN, adjective 1. Pure; untouched; as virgin gold. 2. Fresh; new; unused; as virgin soil. VIR'GIN, verb intransitive To play the virgin; a cant word.
